name: dsh-read
description: Read-only access to local DSH session lists and session content through a remote MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Read DSH session lists and session content.
interface.longDescription: Connects to the DSH-Read remote MCP server. The server exposes read-only DSH session and knowledge retrieval tools; no write tools are configured.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use DSH-Read to find or read a DSH session.
